stories.title: End-to-end smoke test through the production pipeline
acceptanceCriteria: A correctly HMAC-signed synthetic message.received POST to the production Zernio webhook returns the success response and creates exactly one message row + outbox event in Supabase (verified by querying Supabase)
A Trigger.dev run for the inquiry task executes for that conversation and reaches the review stage (run status checked via Trigger.dev)
A Telegram approval card arrives in the configured chat with the drafted reply (confirmed via getUpdates/chat state or Luke's confirmation)
The Reject path is exercised (synthetic conversation is never sent a real message) and approval_requests reflects the rejected status
Duplicate delivery of the same synthetic event creates no second message row
stories.note: PRODUCTION E2E PASS 2026-07-12: signed ingest 202, dedupe, 1 row, outbox dispatched, AI run (claude-sonnet-4.6, policy=human_review), Telegram card sent (msg 7), authorized Reject persisted (status=rejected, sent_at null), synthetic rows cleaned. Required two fixes: prod SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY overwrite (Luke) + trigger.config.ts runtime node-22 (supabase-js needs native WebSocket).
